every compound-specific empirical claim in the supplied query prior or cited
record cards. Repeated records and multiple cards from one context are not

All visible L1 oral-bioavailability records in the transferable contexts are at or above 20% (e.g., betaxolol 80–89%, perindopril 65–75%, encainide 76–78%, vernakalant ~60%, atenolol ~51%, perindoprilat 30±6%), so there is no affirmative evidence for F<20%.

evidence_gaps: No direct oral bioavailability measurement for the query molecule itself is present in the visible L1 cards.
The exact absorption and first-pass conversion of the ethyl ester and amidoxime prodrug moieties in the query are not directly evidenced.
The closest analog AZD0837 has a lower F bound of 22%, which is close to the 20% threshold, so the margin is modest.
No low-F comparator context is available to calibrate negative evidence.
content.decision_summary: Predicted high because the query is structurally analogous to AZD0837, a human oral prodrug with absolute bioavailability of 22–55%, and all visible L1 F records are ≥20%; the mixed physicochemical prior is not affirmative evidence for F<20%.
